hardware.label: Push pin for the back panel
Screw with washer for the bracket
Wall screw with washer 100823 (screw not included)

tools.label: Soft surface to work on (rug or blanket)
Drill for the wall holes (not shown in the manual)

steps.title: Dowels into the boards
steps.text: Tap the 16 wooden dowels into the holes in the ends of the three boards and the plinth.

steps.title: Cam bolts into the sides
steps.text: Lay both side panels on a rug, inner face up, and screw six cam bolts into each one.
tools: Soft surface to work on (rug or blanket)

steps.title: Boards onto the first side
steps.text: Stand the plinth, the bottom board and the fixed shelf on one side panel, with their dowels in its holes.

steps.title: Lock the boards with cam locks
steps.text: Push four cam locks into the holes and turn them clockwise with a flat screwdriver to lock them.

steps.title: Put on the top board
steps.text: Put the top board on the side and lock it with two cam locks.

steps.title: Put on the second side
steps.text: Turn the second side over and lower it onto the dowels and cam bolts.

steps.title: Lock the second side
steps.text: Lock the second side with the other six cam locks.

steps.title: Slide in the back panel
steps.text: Turn the bookcase onto its front.

steps.title: Slide in the back panel
steps.text: Unfold the back panel and slide it into the grooves from the bottom.

steps.title: Fix the back panel
steps.text: Fix the back panel with 18 push fasteners: push a plug through each hole, then press a pin into it.

steps.title: Fix the bookcase to the wall
steps.text: Stand the bookcase up and push it against the wall.
steps.warning: Always fix the bookcase to the wall: it can tip over and cause serious injuries.

steps.title: Fix the bookcase to the wall
steps.text: Screw a wall bracket onto the top at the back on each side, with a screw and washer.

steps.title: Fix the bookcase to the wall
steps.text: Drill a hole for each bracket, push in a plug and fix the bracket with a screw and washer.
steps.note: Wall screws and plugs are not included: choose ones that suit your wall.
tools: Drill for the wall holes (not shown in the manual)

steps.title: Push in the shelf supports
steps.text: Push the 16 shelf supports into the holes at the heights you want.

steps.title: Lay in the shelves
steps.text: Lay the four shelves on the supports.
